liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Bird Song** (3 reviews): Reviewer thinks this Bird Song could rank among the best ever played; Reviewer counts this among their favorite performances of the song [32][37][39]
- **Dark Star** (2 reviews): The band and Branford move through it with ease; Described as psychedelic jazz rather than country or rock Dead [39][41]
- **Knockin' On Heaven's Door** (2 reviews): Possibly the best version ever; Marsalis gives it an abstract edge; Reviewer's favorite version; Jerry sounds deeply emotional [34][37]
- **Eyes of the World** (1 review): Called legendary; reviewer believes it appears on Without a Net [40]
- **The Wheel** (1 review): The Wheel into Throwing Stones into Lovelight stood out in the second set with Branford [37]
- **Throwing Stones** (1 review): Reviewer calls it the best version they have heard [36]

## Setlist highlights

- **I think**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [42]
- **Sounds like Eyes**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [42]

## The recordings

- **gd1990-03-29.127385.mtx.eichorn.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 21 songs; 158 min; rated 5/5 by 4 [1]
- **gd1990-03-29.mtx.hansokolow.97118.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 18 songs; 158 min; rated 4.75/5 by 8 [2]
- **gd1990-03-29.nak300.andrewf.83612.flac16**: source not stated; 18 songs; 157 min; rated 5/5 by 4 [3]
- **gd1990-03-29.AKG451.Berger.Currier.Keo.121843.Flac1644**: source not stated; 18 songs; 163 min [4]
- **gd90-03-29.sbd.hinko.24996.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 17 songs; 152 min; rated 4.88/5 by 16 [16]. Said about its sound: This copy is judged better in quality than the other two on the site [35]
- **gd90-03-29.aud-fob.set2.unknown.1317.sbeok.shnf**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 9 songs; 104 min; rated 4.53/5 by 34 [29]. Said about its sound: Some crowd is audible, but cheers and claps don't appear where you'd expect them near the mics; Blends audience energy with soundboard clarity; Phil is easier to hear [30][31]

## Around the show

- Marsalis sat in during the second set [34]
- Branford Marsalis plays on Bird Song and throughout the entire second set [3]
- Branford Marsalis played saxophone on Bird Song, Promised Land, the whole second set and encore [4]
- Unlike other Schoeps FOB tapes from this tour, which the reviewer has heard many of [30]
- Preferred over the Healy 24-track mixdown soundboard, which sounds somewhat over-produced by comparison [31]
- Ranked with the 09-20-1990 Dark Star and 12-31-78 as the best Dark Stars after the song's retirement [39]
- Reviewer says neither 12-31-90 nor 09-10-91 matches this show's magic [41]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1990-03-29.127385.mtx.eichorn.flac16**: taped by Roger Eichorn; transferred by Roger Eichorn; source: Matrix from SBD (shnid=33925) and AUD (shnid=91347) [1]. Also: Main source is a soundboard taken from DAT to CD; patches come from a purported FOB tape; Patch source is likely soundboard or matrix, shnid 1317; used for Eyes through Lovelight and Knockin'; Keith Litzenberger recorded with Sennheiser ME-80s into a Technics SV-MD1 DAT, transferred via Tascam DA-30MKII [1]
- **gd1990-03-29.mtx.hansokolow.97118.flac16**: transferred by hansokolow; source: matrix of DSBD: shnid=????? and DAUD: shnid=91347 by hansokolow using ProTools [2]. Also: Matrix made by hansokolow in ProTools, finished October 15th, 2008, from all-digital sources of unknown lineage; Litzenberger's Sennheiser ME-80 DAT recording; first set on R-90 tape, second set on R-120; DAT master transferred in the Flying Gonz studios on 4/11/2008 [2]
- **gd1990-03-29.nak300.andrewf.83612.flac16**: taped by Andrew F; transferred by Andrew F.; source: Nakamichi CM300's with CP4 shotgun capsules > Sony TC-D5M > Maxell MX-90's, with Dolby off. Mics on stand aprx 7-feet high, pointed at stacks, set up in… [3]
- **gd1990-03-29.AKG451.Berger.Currier.Keo.121843.Flac1644**: taped by B.R. And Mr. Currier; transferred by Rob Berger and Keo; source: Recorded By B.R. And Mr. Currier Recorded From The OTS; AKG451 With Shotguns>AKG 9V Phantom Power Box>Sony TCD-D10 (Rob Berger's)> Sony TCD-D10>(B.R.'s Patch);… [4]
- **gd90-03-29.sbd.hinko.24996.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Darryl Hinko; source: Soundboard (Hinko) [16]
- **gd90-03-29.aud-fob.set2.unknown.1317.sbeok.shnf**: source: Audience (matrix??) [29]. Also: Reviewer bets this set-two source is a Healy matrix, not a Schoeps front-of-board tape; Reviewer believes the source is a matrix because it's too clean to be purely audience [30][31]

claims.text: Reviewer bets this set-two source is a Healy matrix, not a Schoeps front-of-board tape
Some crowd is audible, but cheers and claps don't appear where you'd expect them near the mics
Unlike other Schoeps FOB tapes from this tour, which the reviewer has heard many of
Reviewer believes the source is a matrix because it's too clean to be purely audience
Blends audience energy with soundboard clarity; Phil is easier to hear
Preferred over the Healy 24-track mixdown soundboard, which sounds somewhat over-produced by comparison
Reviewer thinks this Bird Song could rank among the best ever played
Marsalis sat in during the second set
Possibly the best version ever; Marsalis gives it an abstract edge
This copy is judged better in quality than the other two on the site
Reviewer calls it the best version they have heard
Reviewer counts this among their favorite performances of the song
Reviewer's favorite version; Jerry sounds deeply emotional
The Wheel into Throwing Stones into Lovelight stood out in the second set with Branford
Ranked with the 09-20-1990 Dark Star and 12-31-78 as the best Dark Stars after the song's retirement
The band and Branford move through it with ease
A showcase version of Bird Song, in a tight first set
Called legendary; reviewer believes it appears on Without a Net
Reviewer says neither 12-31-90 nor 09-10-91 matches this show's magic
Described as psychedelic jazz rather than country or rock Dead
Main source is a soundboard taken from DAT to CD; patches come from a purported FOB tape
Patch source is likely soundboard or matrix, shnid 1317; used for Eyes through Lovelight and Knockin'
Keith Litzenberger recorded with Sennheiser ME-80s into a Technics SV-MD1 DAT, transferred via Tascam DA-30MKII
Matrix made by hansokolow in ProTools, finished October 15th, 2008, from all-digital sources of unknown lineage
Litzenberger's Sennheiser ME-80 DAT recording; first set on R-90 tape, second set on R-120
DAT master transferred in the Flying Gonz studios on 4/11/2008
Bird Song tape flip patched with a first-generation cassette from the original taper's copy
Dark Star tape flip patched using shnid 1317; set two is seamless
Branford Marsalis plays on Bird Song and throughout the entire second set
Branford Marsalis played saxophone on Bird Song, Promised Land, the whole second set and encore
AKG 451 recording from Berger's setup; copies from Currier derived from B.R.'s original master DAT
The master DATs are no longer available, making this release the source for the show
